description: Ministry of Higher Education, Technology & Innovations - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex.No. 1469/38 of 03.11.2006 which Specifies the Faculties & Departments of the University of Moratuwa
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of a legal schedule under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It constitutes a regulatory matter where the Minister is exercising statutory powers to modify the structure of a university by adding a new Faculty of Medicine and its departments. While it names a specific minister (Dr. Bandula Gunawardana), the core content is about legal/regulatory action (amending a previous order through statutory instrument) rather than about government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The naming of the minister is incidental to the regulatory function being performed.
